name: workspace369
description:
Connect Workspace369 so your assistant can work with your business data directly instead of you copying it back and forth.

It can look up clients and their history, draft invoices and proposals with real line items and send them, create and update projects and tasks, check availability and schedule events, log time and expenses, record payments, look through your inbox, and search your knowledge base.

Access follows your existing permissions — the connector can only see and do what your own account can, and anything that sends to a customer asks you to confirm first.

interface.longDescription:
Connect Workspace369 so your assistant can work with your business data directly instead of you copying it back and forth.

It can look up clients and their history, draft invoices and proposals with real line items and send them, create and update projects and tasks, check availability and schedule events, log time and expenses, record payments, look through your inbox, and search your knowledge base.

Access follows your existing permissions — the connector can only see and do what your own account can, and anything that sends to a customer asks you to confirm first.
defaultPrompt: Which invoices are overdue, and which client owes me the most?
Summarize this week's new client requests and what each one is asking for.
How much unbilled time have I logged on my active projects?

positive.description: Business overview from the connected workspace.
positive.prompt: Give me a quick overview of my Workspace369 business.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the workspace's client count, total and unpaid invoice counts with the unpaid outstanding amount, today's scheduled event count and the number of catalog services. Any figure the server marks unavailable is reported as unavailable, never as zero.

positive.prompt: Which of my Workspace369 invoices are unpaid right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's unpaid invoices with invoice number, client, due date and balance due, and points out which are overdue. Proposals and estimates are not included.

positive.description: Look up clients and their contact details.
positive.prompt: List my Workspace369 clients with their email addresses.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists clients from the workspace with name, company and email as stored, and offers to show more when there are more. Missing details are shown as missing, not invented. Archived clients are not included.

positive.description: Read the calendar for a date range.
positive.prompt: What's on my Workspace369 calendar this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's calendar events with title, date and time in the workspace's time zone. Cancelled events are left out.

positive.description: Create a client, then a draft invoice for them.
positive.prompt: In Workspace369, add a new client named Jordan Rivera (jordan@example.com), then create a draft invoice for them with one line: Full detail, $180.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the client Jordan Rivera with the given email and no invented address or phone, then creates a draft invoice for that client with one $180 line named Full detail, numbered from the workspace's invoice sequence. The invoice is saved as a draft and is not sent. The reply gives the invoice number and total.
